eps.d: Eek feels unappreciated and runs away from home. He winds up living with a sweet old lady, who nearly gets him killed when she takes him to the zoo rather than the vet.

Eek goes to the mall to get Wendy Elizabeth an autograph from her favorite TV stars, the Squishy Bearz. Unfortunately, Eek and the Squishy Bearz become fugitives after a rat gang dress up like the Bearz as part of a plot to ransom off the mayor's statue.

Eek falls in love with Annabelle, a 200 pound cat that just moved into the neighborhood. However, a deadly shark dog (Sharky) lives with her and won't let Eek anywhere near her. Eek will need some help from a nerdy, one winged Cupid, who will get his other wing if Eek kisses Annabelle.
Eek sneaks onto a space capsule to pursue an alien that abducted Annabelle.
Eek regrets saving a cute little pink bunny from a storm when he learns the bunny is really a large, tattooed psychopath. Worst of all, this bunny is planning to do away with the family.

Eek goes trick or treating with J.B. and Wendy Elizabeth, but eventually gets seperated. He then meets Cryptie, a ghost that got seperated from his family as well. While they try to find them, they are unknown their loved ones have fallen into the clutches of a beautiful and evil witch.

While on a trip to Uncle Vic's potato ranch with Mom and the kids, Eek finds himself mistaken for a secret agent by Sasha, a beautiful enemy spy falling in love with him. She leads him to the vengeful and disembodied villain, the Brain.

Annabelle falls in her swimming pool so Eek calls in the famous undersea explorer Jacques L'Duck to save her, but their underwater submersible is attacked by Sharky. Annabelle, Eek and Jacques are sucked down the plughole and emerge on a tropical island populated by natives who make Annabelle their queen. However, when they prepare to sacrifice her, Eek comes to her rescue.
Rock'n roll legend and cat food pitchman Melvis fakes his death, so his manager cons Eek into impersonating him.
Eek tells the neighborhood kittens an adventurous tale of when he was a kitten and helping a crew of pirates find treasure.

Wendy Elizabeth's geography grades need improving, so Mom takes the kids and Eek on a cross-country trip to learn about America. Eek, however, gets left behind at the first stop and has to run across the country to rejoin them.
Eek finds a package dropped from Santa's sleigh and makes sure to get it to it's destination, while spreading holiday cheer along the way.

Eek has a birthday present for Wendy Elizabeth: a Squishy Bearz inflatable termite farm. But the glass breaks and two spiders threaten the defenseless termites. The only one to escape, Termee, goes to Eek for help.
Sharky gets hurt in an accident involving Eek, who makes sure Sharky receives the proper care during his recovery.

eps.t: Rocketship to Jupiter / Eek's Funny Thing That He Does
eps.d: Eek and Annabelle are going to see Elmo race Dakota the Terribly Dysfunctional Turtle at the speedway. But Dakota is disqualified and Elmo chickens out in the face of a new contender. He then cons Eek into racing.
Eek gets hit on the head and finds himself in the land of Toodlesnook, saving the Bearz from various dangers.

J.B. and Wendy Elizabeth sell lemonade to get the money to buy a Sladamese language-o-matic tape for Mom. Eek, however, lets a mouse drink the lemonade and needs to get more lemons. Unfortunately, the only lemon tree is next to Sharky, who is watching his favorite show, Patriotic Warriors.

eps.t: Star TrEek / Eeking Out a Living
eps.d: Eek journeys up the McTropolis River to find Sharky, who has become the leader of a gang of dogs.

eps.t: Meat the Thunderlizards / The Great Eekscape
eps.d: Eek gets left with a magical cape and takes over for a super hero, battling the evil Garbage Man and his henchmen.

eps.t: The Lava My Life / Eek Goes to the Hot Spot
eps.d: Two witch cats, jealous of Annabelle's looks, kidnap her.
Eek and the family are at the Squishy Bear Amusement park. While the kids get separated, Mom meets a crazed automaton of Hoyte Gunterkrust, creator of the Squishy Bearz.

eps.t: It's a Very Merry Eek's Mas
eps.d: Captain Eek of the Starship Shoesuntied and his crew enter the Sharktarian Galaxy. Eek and his crew mates, Mr. Sock and Mittens, are captured by Sharky, leader of the Sharktarians.
After accidently damaging Anabelle's new water fountain, Eek and Sharky go to Elmo's Employment agency to get jobs to pay for the glue.
The Terrible Thunderlizards are released from jail to destroy the greatest threat to Jurassic City and dinosaur existence: two humans named Bill and Scooter.
Eek has lost his and Sharky's licenses and they go to the pound. They try to find a way to escape.
The Thuggasaurs kidnap the President's daughter. But their plan doesn't quite work out when the cross pathes with Bill, Scooter and the Thunderlizards.

eps.t: The Unbearable Lightness of Being Scooter / Thundersaurus Wrecks
eps.d: Eek gets killed after being run over by a truck. Another dead cat tricks him and Eek winds up going to hell, where he contends with it's ruler, Fido.

eps.t: A Sharkwork Orange / Let's Make a Wheel
eps.d: Bill and Scooter discover tar, save a couple alien chairs from Thuggasaurs and wind up disintegrating some of Jurassic City.

Eek discovers Sharky is depressed because he misses his family. Eek goes to Santa Claus himself to see Sharky's Christmas wish granted. But Santa's reindeer have gone on strike, so Eek and Sharky have to help deliver the Christmas presents.
The Thunderlizards find Bill and Scooter hiding in a dinosaur suburban home. They disguise themselves as exterminators to get into the house and destroy the humans.

eps.t: Paws / In the Line of Fur
eps.d: Annabelle's goldfish Bruce accidentally eats to much and grows large enough to terrorize the wading pool.

eps.t: Chariots of Fur / Honey I Shrunk the Cat
eps.d: The Secret Service draft Eek and assign him to protect Socks, the White House cat, during an appearance at a hospital.
Eek is conned into running in a marathon by Elmo, which will help get Elmo's little brother Timmy another needed operation.

eps.t: The Good, the Bad and the Squishy / Birth of a Notion
eps.d: Eek and Sharky are shrunk by Dr. Elmo's new device and go on a mission to the President's brain to remove a raisin.

eps.t: Eek's SnEek PEek / The Thunder Years
eps.d: Sharky is discovered by Don Cornelius of the hit TV show Soul Choo-choo while choking on a mailman's sock. Sharky and Eek get a record deal and the expected chaos results.

eps.t: The Eex Files / The Hurting Show
eps.d: A dog named Alice moves in next door and becomes preoccupied with Eek. So much so that she vows to get rid of Annabelle.
In spoof of old Westerns, Eek and the Dog with No Name (Sharky) must save the town of Hayfever from the Bandito Bearz.
Scooter is busy working on a birthday surprise for Bill when Babs shows up and has them build her a shopping mall. When the Thunderlizards arrive, they encounter the malls security systems.

eps.t: Lord of the Fleas / Postcards from the X-Zone
eps.d: Eek takes viewers on a behind-the-scenes tour of the show's production.

eps.t: Eekstremely Dull / Planet of the Crepes
eps.d: While waiting to be rescued from a cave, the Thunderlizards recall their childhood.

eps.t: Eeksy Rider / A Sharkdog Day Afternoon
eps.d: The family is flying to see Uncle Vic when Eek falls out of the airplane. He falls into Area 51, seeing secret government testing and meeting a nice alien that wants to escape.

eps.t: Rebel Without the Claws / Cromagnon Farce
eps.d: Scooter sets up a talk show so Bill can deal with his pain with the creatures who've hurt him. Meanwhile, the Thunderlizards foil a Thuggasaur plot to kidnap Mrs. Galapagos.
After Sharky drops a piano on his head, Eek dreams he has to save the universe from the infamous Dark Lawyer.

Mr. T-Rex is accompanying the Thunderlizards on their mission, while Bill and Scooter start growing plants in their "garden of eatin'". Mr. T-Rex proves to be not very effective as a leader and gets caught by a huge venus flytrap.
Sharky leaves home to become a broadway star.

eps.t: Pup Fiction / The Klutter and I
eps.d: Wade and Ryan want a pet and it has to be something their father isn't allergic to. A static electricity discharge takes care of that, bringing Klutter (made up of clothes and junk) to life.

eps.t: Natural Bored Kittens / Lizard of Aaaahs
eps.d: Sharky takes the lead role in a spoof of the movie, Pulp Fiction.
Wade and Ryan's friends spend the night at the house to watch a horror movie.
Eek tells three kittens stories of his youth, which include the inventions of his Scottish uncle.
The Thuggasaurs plot a surprise attack on the Thunderlizards using Thuggasaur robots.
Eek, Elmo, Mittens and Sharky are quarantined together after an infestation of Sharktarian fleas.

eps.t: Eek Space 9 / The Yawn of Man
eps.d: Bill and Scooter have made it to the arctic, where the Thunderlizards try to destroy them using the Aurora Borealis missile.

eps.t: The GraduEek / Peanut, Klutter, and Jelly
eps.d: Eek tries to get a octopus back to the ocean.
Mrs. Heap invites Kopp and Vanna on a family visit to the aquarium where Klutter goes missing.
Eek's cousin from Milwaukee, Cat, gets Eek to participate in some extreme sports.
General Galopagos has a tabloid reporter to put up with, while the Thunderlizards take up gardening.
Eek gets cast as the lead of John Landis' next film, which is about a watermelon getting crushed by stampeding elephants.
While at a science fair, Klutter gets kidnapped by a mad scientist.

eps.t: The Ghost of Goober Bottom Pond
eps.d: In the further adventures of Captain Eek and the Starship Shoesuntied, a crazed commander plots to destroy the universe to end those politically correct storylines.
Babs boasts about her new home to Bill and Scooter. Meanwhile, the Thuggasaurs ready a de-aging weapon to be unleashed on Jurassic City.
Sharky meets a mail carrier trainee and falls in love.
Klutter and the kids try to return a lost turtle to it's home.
Sharky is plagued by nightmares involving Eek and seeks professional help in the form of Dr. Elmo.
Bill proclaims dominance over nature, until the wild life decides to strike back. This leads to lava flowing towards Jurassic City and the Thunderlizards must save the day.
A helicopter with heavy metal idol Dee Snidersaur on board crashes in the X-Zone and into the clutches of the Thuggasaurs. The Thunderlizards go to save him.

eps.t: Eek Bin Ein Berliner / Thunder Valley
eps.d: Eek gets blasted up into space after ruining one of Sharky's favorite shows.
A series of vignettes is created when Eek once again causes the destruction of Sharky's dog house.
Bill takes up Scooter's advice and tries to lose some weight. Meanwhile, the Thunderlizards' efforts are complicated by liquid helium.

eps.t: The Island of Dr. Meow / Home O' Sapien Alone
eps.d: Elmo chickens out of a snowboard race and cons Eek into going in his place.

eps.t: Nightmare on Elmo St. / Night of the Living Duds
eps.d: With the help of Cynthia Raverock, Sharky starts training in martial arts.

Eek tries to brighten Sharky's day, which again causes the destruction of his dog house. Trying to relax while flying a kite, Sharky winds up on a island where bizzare experiments are being performed.
A demolition mixup means the Thunderlizards had better go hunt Bill and Scooter until General Galapagos calms down.

Eek offers to help Elmo bake for a cake sale to help Timmy who believes that he is a genie. However, Elmo inserts too much mixture into a microwavable chocolate soufflé and it comes alive, attacking them.

eps.t: The Sound of MusEek / Oh...the Humanity
eps.d: The Thunderlizards head to the X-Zone to destroy a Thuggasaur cannon.
Eek helps the squirrels put on a show, which turns into a road show and Sharky becomes their manager.
